edits: Each case decodes the event of encoded_loop.json with `field` changed, to `value` or with `append` added after its text, and must fail an assertion with `failure`.

cases.name: a character below the format
cases.failure: character 899 lies below the encoded format

cases.name: a character above the format
cases.failure: character 899 lies above the encoded format

cases.name: text that ends inside a number
cases.failure: the encoded text ends inside a number

cases.name: a number of more than seven chunks
cases.failure: a number holds at most 7 chunks

cases.name: a point of one number
cases.failure: a point holds a latitude and a longitude

cases.name: no point
cases.failure: a path holds at least one point

cases.name: no stop
cases.failure: a path holds at least one stop

cases.name: a stop before the stop before it
cases.failure: stop 1 lies before the stop before it

cases.name: points that are no text
cases.failure: encoded numbers must be a string

cases.name: an empty trip identifier
cases.failure: a trip identifier must not be empty

cases.name: a trip identifier that is no text
cases.failure: a trip identifier must be text

cases.name: a service date that is no integer
cases.failure: a service date must be an integer
